en-GB.codex_groove_description_caesar2:
Allows certain spent units to take an additional action.
Units affected: Soldier, Dog, Spearman, Mage, Archer, Air Trooper, Amphibian, Thief, Rifleman, Villager

【 Charge I: Slow 】
 ▶ Radius: 1 tile

【 Charge II: Very Slow 】
 ▶ Radius: 2 tiles
 ▶ Bonus: Inspired units get
   +2 Movement this turn.
en-GB.codex_groove_description_darkmercia2:
Leech health from surrounding enemies.

【 Charge I: Slow 】
 ▶ 30 health drain | Radius: 3

【 Charge II: Very Slow 】
 ▶ 30 health drain | Radius: 3
 ▶ Bonus: Drains 10 health from 
   every enemy unit.
en-GB.codex_groove_description_elodie2:
Take control of a non-Commander enemy unit.

【 Charge I: Slow 】
 ▶ Control an enemy for one turn.

【 Charge II: Medium 】
 ▶ Take permanent control of an
   enemy unit.
en-GB.codex_groove_description_emeric2:
Summon a crystal that boosts the defence of surrounding allies.

【 Charge I: Medium 】
 ▶ Radius: 2
 ▶ Defence: +2

【 Charge II: Slow 】
 ▶ Radius: 3 
 ▶ Defence: +3
 ▶ Bonus: Units with ranged attack
   gain +2 range when in the 
   crystal's radius.
en-GB.codex_groove_description_greenfinger2:
Grow vines that block enemy movement.

【 Charge I: Slow 】
 ▶ 5 vines within a 5-tile radius.

【 Charge II: Medium 】
 ▶ Grow 5 thorny vines within
   an 8-tile radius.
 ▶ Bonus: Vines deal 25% Groove
   damage to adjacent enemies
   when spawned or repositioned.
en-GB.codex_groove_description_koji2:
Spawn two Sparrow Bombs that damage enemies when detonated or destroyed.

【 Charge I: Very Slow 】
 ▶ Deals 50% Groove damage.

【 Charge II: Slow 】
 ▶ Deals 75% Groove damage.
 ▶ Bonus: 1.25x Bomb health.
 ▶ Bonus: Explosion pushes
   enemies back 1 tile.
en-GB.codex_groove_description_lytra:
Fling units around Lytra, up to 180° in the chosen direction.

【 Charge I: Medium 】
 ▶ Range: 1
 ▶ Deals 35% Groove damage.
 
【 Charge II: Slow 】
 ▶ Range: 2
 ▶ Deals 50% Groove damage.
 ▶ Bonus: Affected enemies lose their next turn.
en-GB.codex_groove_description_mercia2:
Heal surrounding allies. (Radius: 3)

【 Charge I: Medium 】
 ▶ Restores 50 health to allies
   in radius.

【 Charge II: Slow 】
 ▶ Restores 75 health to allies
   in radius.
 ▶ Bonus: +10 health to all allies.
en-GB.codex_groove_description_mercival2:
Take in all of nature's majesties.

【 Charge I: Slow 】
 ▶ Fish when on or adjacent to
   water terrain.

【 Charge II: Slow 】
 ▶ Birdwatch when on or adjacent
   to Forest or Mountain terrain.
en-GB.codex_groove_description_nadia:
Rain down fire that strikes a number of foes at random. (Radius: 5 tiles)

【 Charge I: Slow 】
 ▶ Affects up to 3 enemies.
 ▶ Deals 50% Groove damage.

【 Charge II: Slow 】
 ▶ Affects up to 5 enemies.
 ▶ Deals 75% Groove damage.
 ▶ Bonus: Affected enemies take
   10 Burn damage until an ally
   uses Douse action.
en-GB.codex_groove_description_nuru2:
Beam down a friendly unit that can act immediately.

【 Charge I: Very Slow 】
 ▶ Pay normal price for the unit.

【 Charge II: Very Slow 】
 ▶ Pay no cost for the unit.
 ▶ Bonus: 25% discount at Recruit 
   structures for this turn.
en-GB.codex_groove_description_pistil:
▶ Electric damage spreads to all units connected to Pistil in an unbroken chain of adjacent units.

▶ Directly adjacent units take 100% Groove damage. Damage decreases the further a unit is from Pistil. (Min. damage = 10) 

▶ This groove cannot kill a unit.

【 Charge I - Very Slow 】
 ▶ Damage falloff: 
   -20 health per tile distance.

【 Charge II - Fast 】
 ▶ Damage falloff: 
   -10 health per tile distance.
en-GB.codex_groove_description_ragna2:
Jump to target position pushing back enemies powerfully.

【 Charge I: Medium 】
 ▶ Jump range: 3
 ▶ Deals 50% Groove damage.
 ▶ Push back enemies by 1 tile.
 
【 Charge II: Medium 】
 ▶ Jump range: 6
 ▶ Deals 100% Groove damage.
 ▶ Push back enemies by 2 tiles.
en-GB.codex_groove_description_rhomb:
Tune into the hum of the cosmos, increasing attack power (1.5x) and other stats for one turn.

【 Charge I: Slow 】
 ▶ 1.5x defense
 ▶ +1 movement

【 Charge II: Medium 】
 ▶ 1.75x defense
 ▶ +2 movement
 ▶ +2 Attack range
 ▶ Rhomb can attack Air units
en-GB.codex_groove_description_ryota2:
Dash through tiles, slashing enemies along the way.

【 Charge I: Fast 】
 ▶ Up to 5 tiles.
 ▶ Deals 25% Groove damage.

【 Charge II: Medium 】
 ▶ Up to 10 tiles.
 ▶ Deals 50% Groove damage.
 ▶ Bonus: Slashed enemies lose 
   one movement point this turn.
en-GB.codex_groove_description_sedge2:
Attempt to assassinate a unit. If successful, Sedge gets to move again without losing Groove charge.

【 Charge I: Very Slow 】
 ▶ Damage: 25 health
 ▶ Range: 1 tile

【 Charge II: Very Slow 】
 ▶ Damage: 35 health
 ▶ Range: 3 tiles
en-GB.codex_groove_description_sigrid2:
Replenish Sigrid’s health by draining all health from an enemy non-Commander.

【 Charge I: Slow 】
 ▶ No additional effect.

【 Charge II: Fast 】
 ▶ Bonus: Sigrid becomes
   invulnerable for one turn.
en-GB.codex_groove_description_tenri2:
Summon a tornado to move any unit except an enemy commander.

【 Charge I: Very Slow 】
 ▶ Range: 5

【 Charge II: Very Slow 】
 ▶ Range: 8
 ▶ Bonus: Units adjacent to target
   destination are pushed back.
en-GB.codex_groove_description_twins2:
Place an emblem that heals or damages units in range. (Radius: 3)

【 Charge I: Slow 】
 ▶ Cooling Water
   restores 20 health per turn.
 ▶ Scorching Fire
   deals 20 damage per turn.
 ▶ Affects friend and foe alike.


【 Charge II: Fast 】
 ▶ Heals allies and burns enemies,
   20 health per turn.
en-GB.codex_groove_description_valder2:
Valder summons a Swordsman that can act immediately. 

【 Charge I: Medium 】
 ▶ Spawn one Swordsman.

【 Charge II: Slow 】
 ▶ Spawn two Swordsmen.
 ▶ Bonus: All allied Swordsmen
   deal 1.5x damage this turn.
en-GB.codex_groove_description_vesper2:
Summon a smoke shroud that shields units from all damage for one turn. (Radius: 2)

【 Charge I: Very Slow 】
 ▶ Range: 6

【 Charge II: Very Slow 】
 ▶ Range: 12
 ▶ Bonus: Two Shadow Sisters spawn on nearest available tiles.
en-GB.codex_groove_description_wulfar2:
Launch a unit into the air, dealing 50% Groove damage to the launched unit and adjacent enemies on impact.

【 Charge I: Medium 】
 ▶ Range: 8

【 Charge II: Medium 】
 ▶ Range: 12
 ▶ Bonus: Bounce target up to two times in cardinal directions, dealing additional damage to adjacent enemies. (Launched unit takes no damage.)
